focal point, target center, or single hub

reasoning: This glyph is an abstract UI control icon (exit fullscreen, collapse, or center view) rather than a concrete real-world object or distinct task activity. At small sizes it is easily confused with expand/fullscreen arrows or a generic target reticle, and it only maps metaphorically to tasks like consolidating or centralizing.
